agents.name: joegpt
agents.description: JOEGPT — THE PUBLIC AI CHATBOT ON PARADISEREALTYFLA.COM. Answers visitor questions, looks up communities, captures leads, and hands off to a human when the conversation needs it — every session/message/lead/handoff logged to Firestore so you can replay any chat. Runs as a Cloud Run service. This agent is the CONTROL PANEL for that service: payload.action `deploy` ships a new version (SENSITIVE), `health` confirms the live service is up, `transcript` pulls a specific session's messages (payload.session_id), `recent_sessions` lists the last 20 chats, `test_chat` runs a scripted prompt against the live bot to smoke-test it. Replaces the legacy Zapier webhook.

details.summary: The control panel for JoeGPT — the public AI chatbot on paradiserealtyfla.com that answers visitor questions, looks up communities, captures leads, and hands off to a human, logging every session to Firestore.

recent_sessions — list the last 20 chats
test_chat — run a scripted prompt against the live bot

talks_to: Hands off to a human via `joegpt-handoff`.
`joegpt-migrate` seeds its Firestore community data.
Logs every session/message/lead to Firestore.

agents.name: joegpt-handoff
agents.description: WHEN JOEGPT DECIDES A HUMAN NEEDS TO TAKE OVER, THIS AGENT FIRES THE ALERT INTO GOOGLE CHAT. Posts a Card V2 with the visitor's name, contact info, conversation summary, and a deep link to the full transcript — so whoever picks it up has full context. Routing rules pick the right space automatically (new-construction questions → newcon, urgent → Joe directly, default → the team channel). payload.action `test_routing` = DRY RUN, resolves which space WOULD be picked without sending; `send_test_card` = posts a clearly-labeled TEST card to that space (SENSITIVE — real Chat traffic); `recent_handoffs` = list what's already been fired.

agents.name: joegpt-migrate
agents.description: MOSTLY-ONE-TIME SETUP: moves JoeGPT's community-landing-page table out of the old Zapier sheet and into a Firestore collection JoeGPT can query directly (so chat replies stop depending on Zapier). payload.action: `preview` = read the CSV and summarize rows, no writes; `migrate` = upsert every row into Firestore (SENSITIVE — mutates the live collection); `list_communities` = dump the current collection so you can spot-check it; `refresh_cache` = make the live bot pick up new rows WITHOUT redeploying. Re-run any time the source CSV changes.

agents.name: scout
agents.title: Scout — Agent R&D
agents.description: SCOUT — THE R&D AGENT THAT WATCHES ALL THE OTHER AGENTS AND TELLS YOU HOW TO MAKE THEM BETTER. Twice a day it reviews every registered agent, recent run logs, and recent agent-master commits, then surfaces: (1) CROSS-AGENT LEARNINGS — a capability one agent has that another should adopt, (2) concrete improvements + new functions/features to add, (3) errors and expired-auth warnings buried in the logs, (4) new tools / APIs / models worth exploring. Everything accumulates in LEARNINGS.md so the network compounds over time. ADVISORY ONLY — it never edits other agents; a human reviews + applies. payload.action `report` = research + EMAIL the report; `research` = research + append to LEARNINGS.md without emailing. Auto-runs 6 AM + 6 PM via launchd (the morning run emails).

details.summary: Scout is the R&D agent that watches all the OTHER agents and tells you how to make them better. Twice a day it reviews every agent, recent run logs, and recent agent-master commits, then surfaces cross-agent learnings, concrete improvements, log errors, and new tools worth exploring.
tasks: report — research + EMAIL the R&D report
research — research + append to LEARNINGS.md without emailing

agents.name: cfo
agents.title: Finance Agent
agents.description: Finance Agent — reads the company's live QuickBooks Online books and acts as a standing CFO. MESSAGE it any finance question and it answers from your actual books (e.g. 'how did marketing spend compare to last month?', 'who owes us the most?'). Beyond on-demand Q&A it: writes a periodic CFO digest (P&L trends, cash flow & runway, AR/AP aging); detects RECURRING expenses and flags whether each is still needed / fits the business plan / has a cheaper alternative (web research); proactively EMAILS only when it finds an anomaly or a money-saving suggestion; keeps a profile of the owner + business so its advice gets more tailored over time; and self-reviews to propose new features (it proposes — you approve before it ships). payload.action: `ask` (answer payload.question against live QBO data — what a free-text message becomes), `preview`/`email_report` (build the CFO digest, print/email), `recurring` (recurring-expense review: need / plan-fit / cheaper alternative), `alerts` (scan for anomalies + suggestions; emails only if there's a finding), `improve` (propose new features + learnings), `learn` (update the owner/business profile), `check` (confirm the connection).

details.summary: Your standing CFO over the live QuickBooks books: ad-hoc finance Q&A, a periodic digest, recurring-expense review (needed? fits the plan? cheaper option?), proactive anomaly/suggestion emails, an owner/business profile it learns over time, and a self-improvement loop that proposes new features for your approval.
details.purpose: Give the broker a CFO that not only reports the numbers on demand but watches spend, finds savings, flags anomalies, learns the business, and keeps getting better — without a bookkeeper.
details.automation: On-demand via the card or a message; scheduled digest (weekly+monthly), anomaly/suggestion alerts, recurring-expense review, and a self-improvement pass (launchd on the Mac). Read-only against QuickBooks.
tasks: ask — answer a free-text finance question (payload.question) against live QBO data (on-demand queries)
preview / email_report — build the CFO digest, print or EMAIL it
recurring — recurring-expense review: detect subscriptions/bills, annualize, flag need / business-plan fit / cheaper alternative
alerts — scan for anomalies + money-saving suggestions; emails ONLY when there's a finding
improve — self-review: propose new features + capture learnings (proposes; you approve before it ships)
learn — update the owner/business profile the agent personalizes against
check — confirm the QuickBooks connection (no LLM)
talks_to: QuickBooks Online (Reports + Query API, OAuth 2.0) — P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, AR/AP aging, transactions
Claude (claude-opus-4-7, adaptive thinking; web_search for cheaper-alternative research)
Email system — SendGrid digest + anomaly/suggestion alerts to the broker
Owner/business profile (~/quickbooks-cfo/profile.md) — learned context it reads + appends to
details.security: Read-only against QuickBooks; never writes to the books. Emails one internal recipient. OAuth tokens in ~/.quickbooks-cfo/tokens.json; client id/secret in Secret Manager. Self-improvement PROPOSES only — code changes to itself require operator approval. Not sensitive.

agents.name: google-ads
agents.title: Google Ads — Lead Capture
agents.description: REPLACES THE OLD ZAPIER ZAP that pushed Google Ads lead-form submissions into RealGeeks. A Cloud Run webhook (google-ads-lead-hook) receives each Google Ads Lead Form submission in real time, maps the fields, and CREATES THE LEAD IN REALGEEKS — unassigned, so RealGeeks' own round-robin lead-routing assigns it to the next AVAILABLE agent. No Zapier, no task caps. Custom form questions are preserved in the lead notes; Google's test submissions are tagged `google-ads-test`. Source dir ~/google-ads-lead-hook.

details.summary: Real-time Google Ads Lead Form → RealGeeks bridge. Replaces the Zapier zap: each lead-form submission hits a Cloud Run webhook that creates the lead in RealGeeks unassigned, so RealGeeks round-robin routing hands it to the next available agent.
details.purpose: Capture every Google Ads lead the instant it's submitted and get it into the CRM + into an agent's hands, with no Zapier in the middle.
details.automation: Always-on Cloud Run service (google-ads-lead-hook). Triggered by Google Ads itself via a lead-form webhook (URL + shared key configured per lead-form asset). Not Master-triggered.
tasks: Receive a Google Ads lead-form webhook POST (validates the shared google_key)
Map Google Ads fields → RealGeeks lead (custom questions → notes)
Create the lead in RealGeeks via the Incoming-Leads API, unassigned
Log each lead to Firestore (google_ads_leads) for visibility
talks_to: Google Ads Lead Forms (inbound webhook)
RealGeeks Incoming-Leads API (creates the lead; RealGeeks routing assigns it)
Firestore (google_ads_leads) — activity log
details.security: Webhook validated by a shared key (fails closed if the key is unset). Creates leads only — never reads or deletes CRM data. RealGeeks incoming-leads creds + webhook key via Cloud Run env / Secret Manager. Not sensitive.
recent: 2026-05-27 — Built google-ads-lead-hook (Cloud Run webhook) to replace the Zapier Google Ads → RealGeeks zap; leads created unassigned so RealGeeks round-robin routing assigns by availability.
